 Judgment

This is a charge sheet filed by Byatarayanapura Police station against the accused for the offence punishable Under Section 420, 506 of IPC.
C.C.No.9938/2018 2.
The case of the prosecution in brief is that, the accused No.1 was working at Manyatha Tekpak.
He was doing business as partner.
The Cw.1 expressed his intention to join as partner with the accused.

At that time the accused with an intention to cheat the Cw.1 on 23.07.2015 asked the Cw.1 to join as partner to his company by paying an amount of Rs.2,50,000/- and also himself got transferred an amount of Rs.2,50,000/- from the account of Cw.1 to his account.
Then the accused without doing any business cheated the Cw.1.
On 10.03.2017 when the Cw.1 asked the accused to repay the amount at that time the accused refused to pay the amount and gave life threat to the Cw.1.
Based on the complaint given by Cw.1, Cw.8 registered a case in Cr.No.115/2016 and forwarded FIR to the Court,

thereafter the Cw.8 visited the place of incident and conducted Spot Mahazar in the presence of Shri Nidhi vs Punith on 10 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/143867718/
1 panch witnesses CW.2 and CW.3 and recorded statements of witnesses, having completed the investigation Cw.8 filed the charge sheet against the accused for the aforesaid offence.
3.
After filing of the charge sheet, the presence of the accused was secured.
Thereafter the copies of the charge sheet papers furnished to the accused.
Substance of acquisition read over to the accused.
the accused pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried for the said offence.
4. In order to bring home the guilt of the accused, the prosecution examined one witness as P.W.1 and got C.C.No.9938/2018 marked document at Ex.P.1.

Inspite issuance summons, warrant and proclamation, the presence of Cw.1 to Cw.6 and Cw.8 was not secured, therefore the prayer of Ld.
APP was rejected and Cw.1 to Cw.8 were dropped.

After completion of evidence of the prosecution,
the statement of accused recorded as required u/s 313 of Cr.P.C.
The accused has denied the incriminating circumstances appeared against him in the evidence of prosecution and did not chose to lead the defense evidence.
5. I have heard the arguments from both sides and perused the entire record.
In the facts and circumstances of the case the following points arises for consideration.
POINTS Point No.1:
Whether the prosecution proves an offence punishable Under Section 420 of IPC against the accused beyond all reasonable doubt?

Point No.2: Whether the prosecution proves an offence punishable Under Section 506 of IPC against the accused beyond all reasonable doubt?
6.

Point No.1 & 2: under consideration are answered in the Negative for the following:
C.C.No.9938/2018 REASONS Point No.1 & 2 :
7.

The PSI of Byatarayanapura police station filed the charge sheet against the accused for the offence punishable Under Section 420, 506 of IPC.
8.
In order to bring home the guilt of the accused, the prosecution examined one witnesses as Pw.1.
The Cw.7 who is police officer examined as Pw.1.
The Pw.1 in his evidence deposed that on 18.03.2017 he was deputed to bring the accused to the police station.
Then as per the order Cw.8 he went to the house of the accused and brought the accused to the police station and produced before Cw.8 and given a report as per Ex.P.1.
Except said evidence the Pw.1 is not concerned about any other evidence regarding the commission of offence by the accused.

9. It is the case of the prosecution that, the accused got transferred an amount of Rs.2,50,000/-
from the account of the Cw.1 to his account and cheated the Cw.1 without repayment of said amount and also without doing any business as partner.
But in the present case, inpsite of issuance of summons, warrant and proclamation the presence of Cw.1 to 6 and 8 was secured.
The Cw.1 being the complaint and victim did not appear before the court to depose evidence in support of prosecution case.
The other witnesses also did not appear before the court.

Therefore Shri Nidhi vs Punith on 10 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/143867718/
2 C.C.No.9938/2018 except the evidence of Pw.1, there is no any incriminating evidence against the accused for commission of alleged offence of cheating.

sentences.text: The prosecution has failed to examine the material witness.
Therefore there is no any evidence on record to prove the guilt of the accused.
Therefore, prosecution has failed to prove the guilty of the accused beyond all reasonable doubt.

Accordingly, I answer point No.1 & 2 in the Negative and proceed to pass the following:
ORDER
Exercising the power under section 248 (1) of Cr.P.C. the accused is acquitted for the offences punishable Under Section 420, 506 of IPC.
The bail bond and surety bonds stands cancelled.
